skills.name: a11y-audit
skills.description: Injects axe-core accessibility checks into existing Playwright or Cypress tests, or runs standalone WCAG 2.1 audits on specified pages, and produces a violation report classified by impact level and WCAG criterion.

parameters.name: framework
parameters.description: E2E framework: 'playwright' or 'cypress'. Auto-detected.

parameters.name: pages
parameters.description: Comma-separated page URLs or paths to audit (e.g. '/login,/orders,/dashboard'). If omitted, detects pages from existing E2E tests.

parameters.name: wcag_level
parameters.description: WCAG conformance level: 'A', 'AA', or 'AAA'. Default: AA (most common regulatory requirement).

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: 'inject' to add axe-core checks to existing tests. 'standalone' to run a dedicated accessibility scan. 'report-only' to audit without modifying test files.

skills.name: chaos-testing
skills.description: Generates resilience tests for circuit breakers, retry logic, timeout handling, and graceful degradation — verifying that the application behaves correctly when downstream services fail. Stack-agnostic with support for Spring Boot (Resilience4j), NestJS, FastAPI, and generic HTTP clients.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Path to service client files or directory. If omitted, auto-detects HTTP clients and downstream integrations from the codebase.

parameters.name: framework
parameters.description: Resilience framework: 'resilience4j' (Spring Boot), 'nestjs', 'fastapi', 'generic'. Auto-detected.

parameters.name: scenarios
parameters.description: Comma-separated resilience scenarios: 'circuit-breaker', 'timeout', 'retry', 'fallback', 'bulkhead', 'rate-limit'. Default: all.

skills.name: compliance-audit
skills.description: Generates a compliance gap report and test checklist for GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOX, or ISO 27001. Scans the codebase for compliance-relevant patterns (PII handling, audit logging, data retention, encryption) and maps findings to specific regulatory articles.

parameters.name: framework
parameters.description: Compliance framework(s): 'gdpr', 'hipaa', 'pci-dss', 'sox', 'iso27001', or comma-separated for multiple (e.g. 'gdpr,hipaa'). Use 'all' to apply all frameworks.

parameters.name: industry
parameters.description: Industry context for risk prioritization: 'healthcare', 'finance', 'retail', 'government', 'saas'. Adjusts which requirements are critical vs. informational.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: 'assess' to analyze current state and generate gap report, 'checklist' to generate a test checklist only (no code scanning), 'full' for both.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: 'report' for full compliance gap analysis, 'checklist' for an actionable test checklist, 'csv' for import into GRC tools.

skills.name: contract-coverage
skills.description: Scans a repository for inter-service communication (HTTP, messaging, events), maps consumer-provider relationships, detects missing contract tests, and generates Pact interaction stubs for uncovered integrations.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: 'detect' to report missing contracts only. 'generate' to also create Pact interaction stubs for uncovered integrations.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Directory to scan (defaults to repo root). Use to focus on a specific service or module.

parameters.name: focus
parameters.description: Service name or path to focus the report on (e.g. 'payment-service'). Shows only contracts where this service is consumer or provider.

skills.name: e2e-page-object
skills.description: Generates Page Object Model (POM) classes for Cypress or Playwright from React, Vue, or Angular component files, HTML markup, or route descriptions. Enforces the data-testid selector hierarchy and produces action methods aligned to user behavior.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Path to a component file (React/Vue/Angular), HTML file, or a text description of the page (e.g. 'Order form with amount input, currency selector, submit button').

parameters.name: framework
parameters.description: Target E2E framework: 'cypress' or 'playwright'. Auto-detected if omitted.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name for the POM class (e.g. 'OrderPage', 'LoginPage'). Inferred from source file name if omitted.

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Directory for the generated POM file. Defaults to 'cypress/pages/' or 'tests/pages/'.

skills.name: e2e-spec-to-test
skills.description: Converts a Gherkin feature file into runnable Cypress or Playwright E2E test files following the Page Object Model pattern. Closes the spec-first loop by turning executable specs into production-ready tests with stable selectors and proper async handling.

parameters.name: feature
parameters.description: Path to the .feature file to convert. Typically produced by /tw-exec-spec-generator.

parameters.name: framework
parameters.description: Target E2E framework: 'cypress' or 'playwright'. Auto-detected from cypress.config.* or playwright.config.* if omitted.

parameters.name: pages
parameters.description: Comma-separated page names to generate POM classes for (e.g. 'LoginPage,OrderPage'). If omitted, inferred from feature file scenarios.

parameters.name: base_url
parameters.description: Base URL of the application under test (e.g. 'http://localhost:3000'). Read from framework config if omitted.

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Directory for generated test files. Defaults to 'cypress/e2e/' for Cypress or 'tests/' for Playwright.

skills.name: e2e-test-governor
skills.description: Audits E2E test coverage by mapping user flows and feature files to existing Cypress or Playwright test files, classifies gaps by risk, detects stale or brittle tests, and produces a governance report with actionable recommendations.

parameters.name: framework
parameters.description: E2E framework to audit: 'cypress' or 'playwright'. Auto-detected from config files if omitted.

parameters.name: features_dir
parameters.description: Directory containing .feature files to cross-reference. Defaults to 'specs/' or 'features/' if present.

parameters.name: base_ref
parameters.description: Git ref to diff against (e.g. origin/main). When provided, focuses the report on flows touched by changed code.

parameters.name: strict_selectors
parameters.description: When true, flags any selector that is not data-testid or ARIA-based as a selector health risk.

skills.name: exec-spec-generator
skills.description: Transforms user stories, acceptance criteria, or existing code into executable Gherkin specs with a QA-first blind spots report surfacing scenarios that developers and BAs typically miss.

parameters.name: story
parameters.description: User story text, acceptance criteria, or feature description. Paste inline or provide a file path.

parameters.name: artifact
parameters.description: Path to existing code, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI spec, or JSON schema that contextualizes the story. Optional but improves scenario quality significantly.

parameters.name: stack
parameters.description: Target test framework for generated step stubs (jest/pytest/junit5). If omitted, auto-detected from the repo.

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Directory where the .feature file and blind spots report are saved.

skills.name: flakiness-analyzer
skills.description: Analyzes CI test run history to identify non-deterministic (flaky) tests, classifies them by failure pattern and frequency, and produces a remediation plan. Restores developer trust in the test suite by distinguishing real failures from environmental noise.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Source of test history: 'junit-xml' (reads test-results/ directory) or 'github-actions' (reads via GitHub MCP) or 'gitlab-ci' (reads via GitLab API).

parameters.name: results_dir
parameters.description: Directory containing JUnit XML test result files from multiple CI runs. Used when source=junit-xml.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: Minimum flakiness rate (%) to flag a test as flaky. Default: 10 (fails in 10% of runs with the same code).

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Time window for analysis: '7d', '30d', '90d'. Longer windows surface intermittent flakiness.

skills.name: golden-master
skills.description: Captures behavioral snapshots of a system (Golden Master) and compares future runs against them to detect regressions, unintended behavior changes, or legacy-to-new equivalence during migrations.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Operation mode: 'capture' to record a new Golden Master, 'compare' to diff current output against the saved master.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Identifier for this Golden Master set (e.g. 'order-placement', 'pricing-engine'). Used as directory name under .golden/.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Command, script, or function path to execute for capture/compare. Required for 'capture'. For 'compare', defaults to same target used during capture (stored in manifest).

parameters.name: inputs
parameters.description: Path to a JSON file containing an array of test input objects. If omitted in capture mode, Claude will prompt for or infer representative inputs.

parameters.name: tolerance
parameters.description: Comparison mode: 'strict' (exact byte match) or 'normalized' (masks UUIDs, timestamps, auto-increment IDs before diffing). Default: normalized.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Version tag for the captured master (e.g. 'v1.2.0', 'pre-refactor'). Defaults to current git short SHA.

skills.name: install-toolkit
skills.description: Guides the user through installing tw-ai-toolkit into a consumer repository.

parameters.name: repo_path
parameters.description: Absolute or relative path to the consumer repo root (defaults to current directory)

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Toolkit version tag to install (e.g. v1.0.0). Defaults to latest stable tag.

skills.name: integration-discovery
skills.description: Scans OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specs, Spring controllers, NestJS routes, or Express routers to auto-discover API contracts, generates framework-agnostic Gherkin scenarios for each contract, and produces ready-to-run integration tests — without requiring any manual user story authoring.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Path to OpenAPI/AsyncAPI YAML/JSON, or source directory for annotation scanning (e.g. 'openapi/orders.yaml', 'src/controllers/', 'src/main/java/').

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: 'gherkin' for Gherkin .feature files only, 'tests' for framework-specific test files only, 'both' for Gherkin + tests.

parameters.name: framework
parameters.description: Test framework: 'supertest' (NestJS/Express), 'rest-assured' (Spring), 'httpx' (FastAPI/Django). Auto-detected.

parameters.name: focus
parameters.description: Comma-separated HTTP methods to focus on: 'GET,POST' limits generation to read and create scenarios. Default: all.

parameters.name: contract_mode
parameters.description: 'happy' for 200/201 flows only, 'error' for 4xx/5xx flows only, 'happy+error' for both (default), 'full' adds boundary and auth scenarios.

skills.name: java-test-governor
skills.description: Audits JUnit 5 unit test coverage in a Java/Spring Boot repository, maps production classes to test files, classifies gaps by severity, and generates a structured governance report with actionable remediation decisions.

parameters.name: base_ref
parameters.description: Git ref to diff against (e.g. origin/main). When provided, focuses on changed classes.

parameters.name: jacoco_xml
parameters.description: Path to Jacoco XML coverage report (e.g. target/site/jacoco/jacoco.xml). Enables per-class coverage signals.

parameters.name: test_results_dir
parameters.description: Directory containing Surefire/Failsafe JUnit XML output for failing test detection.

parameters.name: build_tool
parameters.description: Build tool: 'maven' or 'gradle'. Auto-detected from pom.xml or build.gradle.

skills.name: java-test-remediator
skills.description: Consumes a Java/Spring Boot test governance report, assigns Jacoco coverage tiers per class, then generates or updates maintainable JUnit 5 + Mockito test classes to meet tiered line-coverage targets.

parameters.name: report_file
parameters.description: Path to the governance report produced by /tw-java-test-governor. If omitted, uses the most recent TEST_GOVERNANCE_REPORT_*.md.

parameters.name: base_ref
parameters.description: Git ref used by /tw-java-test-governor. Used to regenerate the report if no report file is provided.

parameters.name: build_tool
parameters.description: Build tool: 'maven' or 'gradle'. Auto-detected.

skills.name: lint-component
skills.description: Validates that a toolkit component follows all required conventions and schema rules.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Relative path to the component directory (e.g. skills/lint-component)

skills.name: living-docs
skills.description: Reads passing Gherkin feature files and test results to generate living documentation — human-readable reports showing what behavior is verified, what is pending, and what has failed. Publishes to Confluence, generates HTML, or produces structured Markdown.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Path to .feature files or directory. Defaults to 'features/' or 'specs/'. Can also be a test results directory (JUnit XML, Playwright JSON, Cypress JSON).

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: 'markdown' for .md files, 'html' for standalone HTML report, 'confluence' for Confluence wiki markup ready to publish.

parameters.name: output_dir
parameters.description: Directory where documentation files are saved.

parameters.name: include_pending
parameters.description: When true, includes pending/unimplemented scenarios marked as 'not yet automated'. Default: true.

skills.name: mutation-audit
skills.description: Runs mutation testing (Stryker for TypeScript/JavaScript, mutmut for Python) on tier-A modules identified by the test governor, and produces a mutation score report revealing tests that pass but don't actually catch bugs.

parameters.name: modules
parameters.description: Comma-separated paths to modules to mutate. If omitted, reads tier-A modules from the latest TEST_GOVERNANCE_REPORT_*.md.

parameters.name: framework
parameters.description: Mutation framework: 'stryker' (TypeScript/JS) or 'mutmut' (Python). Auto-detected from project.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout in seconds per module. Mutation testing is slow — default 5 minutes per module.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: Minimum acceptable mutation score (%). Below this threshold the report flags a quality debt warning.

skills.name: performance-baseline
skills.description: Generates k6 (TypeScript/JavaScript) or Locust (Python) performance test scripts from OpenAPI specs or detected API endpoints, establishes latency and error rate thresholds, and compares against previously recorded baselines to detect performance regressions.

parameters.name: spec
parameters.description: Path to OpenAPI YAML/JSON spec file. If omitted, endpoints are detected from Spring controllers or Express/NestJS routes.

parameters.name: tool
parameters.description: Performance tool: 'k6' or 'locust'. Auto-detected: k6 if TypeScript/JS project, locust if Python.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: 'baseline' to establish thresholds from first run, 'compare' to diff against saved baseline, 'generate' to only output scripts without running.

parameters.name: p95_threshold_ms
parameters.description: P95 latency threshold in milliseconds. Requests exceeding this are flagged as regressions. Default: 500ms.

parameters.name: error_rate_threshold
parameters.description: Maximum acceptable error rate (%). Default: 1%.

parameters.name: vus
parameters.description: Virtual users (concurrent load). Default: 10 for baseline, increase for load testing.

skills.name: pipeline-generator
skills.description: Generates a complete CI/CD quality pipeline (GitHub Actions or GitLab CI) that chains all tw-ai-toolkit skills as automated quality gates. Turns the toolkit from tribal knowledge into enforced infrastructure.

parameters.name: platform
parameters.description: CI platform: 'github' or 'gitlab'. Auto-detected from .github/ or .gitlab-ci.yml presence.

parameters.name: stack
parameters.description: Project stack: 'typescript', 'python', or 'java'. Auto-detected from project files.

parameters.name: stages
parameters.description: Comma-separated pipeline stages to include: lint, unit, e2e, contracts, mutation, performance, a11y. Default: lint,unit,e2e,contracts

parameters.name: nightly
parameters.description: When true, generates a separate nightly job for expensive checks (mutation testing, full performance baseline).

parameters.name: fail_on
parameters.description: Pipeline fail threshold: 'critical' (only CRITICAL gaps block merge), 'high' (HIGH + CRITICAL), 'any' (any gap blocks merge).

skills.name: python-test-governor
skills.description: Audits Python unit test coverage, maps production modules to tests, classifies gaps by severity, and generates a structured governance report with actionable remediation decisions.

parameters.name: base_ref
parameters.description: Git ref to diff against (e.g. origin/main). When provided, the report focuses on changed modules.

parameters.name: coverage_xml

parameters.name: source

parameters.description: 'analyze' to report testability issues and refactoring suggestions. 'pr-review' to produce a QA-focused PR review comment. 'score' to output a numeric testability score (0–100) per module.

parameters.name: stack

skills.name: quality-trend
